registration.statement: A molecular dihedral is an ordered four-site periodic carrier with held orientation, not a signed continuum scalar. At the registered 24-sector resolution, structural EmptyOne, each positive sector successor and recurrent One exactly generate the coordinate cycle. Complete cyclic neighbour order forces conformer minima and barriers; each barrier magnitude is the ordered positive Take to its adjacent conformer. The coordinate and operation seal before all fifty NIST angle and energy rows open.
